label: SRX4100 Firewall
description: Juniper SRX4100 - data-centre NGFW: 8x 1G/10G SFP+ (xe-0/0/0-7), 2 dedicated HA fabric ports, 40 Gbps firewall.
notes: The 8 template ports are declared sfp+ explicitly: at 10G both copper (10GBASE-T) and fibre (SFP+) are common, so the connector must not be guessed from the rate.
